scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/types && npm run build -w @atlas/core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @atlas/types && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/core && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @atlas/core && npm run test -w @atlas/web
scripts.sync:static: npm run build -w @atlas/web && rm -rf packages/core/static && cp -R packages/web/dist packages/core/static && rm -rf packages/core/dist/static && cp -R packages/web/dist packages/core/dist/static
